name: 27803 · Rocky Mount, NC
findings: ZIP 27803 (Rocky Mount) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27803 (Rocky Mount) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27803 (Rocky Mount) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
